q: In information geometry, the e-flat submanifold (exponential submanifold) through p has the property that its tangent space at p is:
opts: The set of score functions ∂ log p/∂θ (tangent vectors in the θ-coordinate
A linear subspace of probability distributions
exp: An e-flat (exponential) geodesic from P to Q has the form p_t ∝ p^{1-t} q^t (mixture in the log domain). The e-flat submanifold through P consists of all distributions in the exponential family generated by P. The m-flat submanifold is the mixture family through P.
